name: @wise-evidence/benchmark
description: Milestone 6.1 operational benchmark harness for WiseEvidence. Drives the EXISTING @wise-evidence/ai provider + orchestrator (no new provider, no parallel AI architecture) to compare candidate OpenRouter models on the DEMO study under identical conditions: FULL (six tasks) and ESSENTIAL (four tasks) workloads, token usage, latency, retries, structured-output validity, and cost. Live inference is env-gated and never runs in CI; the offline tests exercise the whole harness deterministically with the mock provider and an injected fake fetch. No fabricated numbers: missing usage/pricing/latency is NULL, never zero.
